title: Assemblyman gets ‘job offer’ from scammer | The Star
text:
Assemblyman gets ‘job offer’ from scammer | The Star
MELAKA: A scammer offered a job to a state assemblyman here, promising to pay him RM800 a day merely by “liking” some YouTube videos.”
She identified herself as “Aisha” in her WhatsApp messages.
